submissions.title: Louisville Metro Council advances data center moratorium
submissions.excerpt: Planning and Zoning Committee voted 7-1 to send a data center moratorium proposal to the full 26-member council

submissions.title: Palm Beach County Zoning Commission Approves AI Data Center Moratorium
submissions.excerpt: Zoning Commission is unanimously recommending a one-year moratorium on large-scale data centers using 50 megawatts or more
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Palm Beach County's Zoning Commission unanimously recommended a one-year moratorium on new large-scale data center applications (threshold: facilities expected to draw >=50 MW), to allow the county to draft new rules on noise, water use, electrical demand and siting. Recommendation advances to another public hearing before final consideration by the Board of County Commissioners, expected in September 2026. Applications submitted before July 7, 2026 continue moving through review under existing rules. No tracked BEP project is located in Palm Beach County, so no projectId was attached.
